what: Blackstone is the world's largest manager of alternative investments: private equity, real estate, private credit and hedge-fund solutions. It earns management fees and a share of profits.
customers: Pension funds, sovereign funds, insurers and wealthy individuals.
moat: A top brand and track record that attract capital, and scale that gives access to the largest deals.
